_why: Ten Laws #2 — no app holds funds. A wallet is not a word, it is PERSISTED STATE. Every durable write must be declared here. "balance": true means this key accumulates a per-actor amount the app treats as owed or held — which the law forbids, so it requires a quoted founder ruling. A per-ORDER price record is not a balance.
_verified: At the time of writing, no Durable Object in this repo accumulates an amount (`+=` over any amount/fcfa/total field): zero matches across all worker sources.
